commands.title: Open Browser Tab in Login Profile…
Set Login Profile for Agent Session…

enumDescriptions: Tabs agent sessions open use the window's default login store, which your own tabs use too: agents are logged in wherever you are.

Every agent session opens its tabs in a private login profile of its own, which starts logged out; agents cannot open tabs in your default store. They can still use named profiles and, with your permission, tabs you opened.
copane.browser.agentLoginStore.markdownDescription: Which login store (cookies, local storage, cache) browser tabs of agent sessions use when neither the agent nor you chose a profile for them. A profile you choose for a session in the Sessions view, or one the agent names, comes first. Login profiles live in memory until VS Code quits; see **Copane: Open Browser Tab in Login Profile…**.
